answer: Streak-based reputation multipliers: identity weight scales as 1.3^s after s consecutive verified epochs at the horizon. A pearl of verified work compounds; a walnut of one-off identities stays at weight 1.0. Splitting an honest streak into k sybils resets each to 1.0, forfeiting roughly 1.3^s/k honest weight — at s=10 that's a 13.8x penalty. The horizon enforces decay on gaps.
